details: Easing tensions between the US and Iran have reduced market risk premiums, contributing to a recovery in global risk assets. Bitcoin neared $76,000 but stalled at $74,700 ahead of next week's US-Iran ceasefire expiry. High short interest indicated by negative funding rates suggests a potential short squeeze to $125,000, though geopolitical uncertainty remains if the ceasefire is not extended.
title: US-Iran Peace Talks Trigger Risk-On Sentiment, Bitcoin Stalls Near $76K
